rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose choice when someone has taken the wrong route or gone in the wrong direction.

example.english: You took the wrong road and went astray.
example.traditional: 你沿住呢條山路行，行錯路喇。
example.jyutping: nei5 jyun4 zyu6 ne1 tiu4 saan1 lou6 haang4 haang4 co3 lou6 laa3

rows.note: Use this when someone cannot find the way or does not know which direction to take.

example.english: I got lost in this mall and went astray.
example.traditional: 我喺呢個商場入面迷路，搵唔到出口。
example.jyutping: ngo5 hai2 ni1 go3 soeng1 coeng4 jap6 min6 mai4 lou6 wan2 m4 dou3 ceot1 hau2

rows.note: Use this for going astray morally or choosing a harmful or criminal path rather than merely getting lost.

example.english: He used to fall in with the wrong crowd and nearly go astray.
example.traditional: 佢以前交錯朋友，差啲行歪路。
example.jyutping: keoi5 ji5 cin4 gaau1 cok3 pang4 jau5 caa1 di1 haang4 waai1 lou6
